queue.name: Frosted Clamshell
queue.prompt: Relight this image. Change nothing else except the lighting. A large soft source sits directly in front and above the subject angled down, with a second soft source or bright reflector directly below angled up, closing around the face like an open shell. Shadows under the nose and chin are almost eliminated, catchlights appear above and below, and the skin carries a cool frosted sheen on the cheekbones, brow and nose bridge. Neutral to slightly cool temperature, even exposure, realistic skin texture with visible pores, natural asymmetry, subtle film grain.

queue.name: Opalescent Glow

queue.name: Dewy High-Key

queue.name: Pearl Softbox Wrap

queue.name: Silk Diffusion
